policy: All nine nongeneric Ascent sleeve label groups are reviewed here; their observations remain unresolved.
Possible products are comparison targets, not confirmed equivalences or additional collectibles.
Two labels can point to the same comparison target without merging their observations.
Existing manufacturer ownership IDs remain unchanged; this review does not change collection progress.
